items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: He had one brother that was quite famous in a quartet that traveled all over the world back then, and his brother's name was James Bartlett Brown.

ctx.x: I know you mentioned your mother played organ. Did your father play any instrument?

No, he used to -- he could play a little piano, and he was the singer. He came from a family of singers. He had one brother that was quite famous in a quartet that traveled all over the world back then, and his brother's name was James Bartlett Brown. I forget the name of the quartet. Oh, they were on the Orpheum circuit or Pantages circuit for years, and he traveled all over. In fact, the whole family was very musical.
I read in one of the biographical sketches that at Pasadena College you were studying pre-med.
